notes.title: For Christmas would you please leave a review for Woolley - pretty please? :)
notes.content:
Since releasing Woolley Mountain over four years ago, we've seen very lucky to get lots of fans and love for our very first commercial game. But, we really haven't had very many reviews! and we need more, and here's a breakdown of why...

[b]Did you know...
[/b]...most new players come through suggestions made by Steam within their own platform? Steam's algorithm takes the number of reviews to dictate how often (and how prominently) each game is shown to new potential players as they browse and play.

[b]...the first algorithm milestone is 10 reviews.
[/b]This is Steam's way of making sure that a game isn't a total stinker.

[b]...next is at 50-reviews.
[/b]This is where a game can earn its Very Positive rating, depending on the positivity of the reviews.

[b]...the next milestone is a massive 500 reviews!
[/b]If we were to reach this it would give Woolley an Overwhelmingly Positive rating and a top spot in the Steam algorithm. We're a long way off, but every single review is included and increases our chances of being seen by new point & click fans.

[b]How can you help?
[/b]It's simple, easy and quick! If you have enjoyed playing Woolley Mountain, please, please, please spare a few seconds to write a short review and help us on our journey to reach that seminal 500 reviews!

I promise that it will truly have a vast impact and help us to create more games in the future.

Thanks again folks!

James

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33321023/23f42aa45a575c4d506fe7235f35facc05c0586a.png[/img]

notes.title: Woolley Mountain soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33321023/d0198d0321a90e946a702e70e3d5b692f0198006.jpg[/img]

Enjoy all the wonderful music from The Mystery Of Woolley Mountain in this rich and eclectic soundtrack from the game. 

All songs written by David Lightfoot and Jonny Barnard.

The Helmholtz Resonators are a renegade group of psychedelic audio scientists who have been playing and writing music together since the turn of the century. They studied acoustic science and the work of Hermann Von Helmholtz, being particularly inspired by his book On the Wires of our Nerves, essential reading for anyone interested in the science of sound and sound synthesis. Heavily inspired by the ethos behind concept albums, the band have created a repertoire of songs that are as eccentric as their image, touching on influences as diverse as The Residents and The Kinks to LCD Soundsystem and Hieronymous Bosch.

Hope you are still enjoying Woolley Mountain, don't forget to leave a review if you haven't yet too, the more the merrier!

Just wanted to let you know that there is loads of cool Woolley Merch over at the website, posters, postcards, spectrum games featured in the game, vinyl, soundtracks, you name it! So go check it out!

http://www.woolleymountain.com/merchandise.html

Also, please join us on our Discord server where we discuss all things Woolley plus talk about the next game we are working on! the link is below!

https://discordapp.com/invite/FzUMs96

Anyways, big love to you all!

Speak soon, and get in touch!

James Lightfoot

notes.title: Woolley Mountain coming April 10!
notes.content:
I am delighted to confirm that The Mystery of Woolley Mountain is being released on April 10th!

Dive in and encounter strange beasts, evil witches, confused automatons and wacky ropemen that lurk within the eccentric point and click -- which was endorsed by none other than legend of the genre Ron Gilbert himself, who pledged toward the game's successful Kickstarter campaign.


The Mystery of Woolley Mountain is an otherworldly point-and-click adventure, which takes inspiration from the likes of Monkey Island, Day of the Tentacle and The Trap Door. Join a renegade crew of time travelling audio scientists as you embark on a fantastical quest to save a group of children from a malevolent witch who has taken them captive on the mysterious island of Woolley Mountain.

Lead developer James Lightfoot of Lightfoot Bros. said: "Woolley Mountain encapsulates everything about us, everything that we embody and love - humour, art, adventure, music, cartoons, other worlds, camaraderie, puzzles and time travel."

"We really hope we’ve created a world that you want to exist and play in over and over again."
